text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: W-whoa, this thing's a scary sight up close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
め、
目の前で見ると威圧感がすごいッス！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
One wrong move, and it'll crush us for sure.
Let's be nice and careful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
少しでも隙を見せればやられそうだ。
気は抜けないね！

text_block_list.name: Jun
text_block_list.text:
If we work as a team, we can overcome it.
Remember your training, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全員でかかれば問題ない相手のはずだ。
連携を忘れずに戦おう！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I could take it down single-handed...
But ah well. Let's see what you're made of, metal brute!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワタシ一人で十分なんだがな。
まあいい。
早速、
味見させてもらおうか！
